skills.name: Taste Good, Agumon?
skills.description: Taichi feeds Agumon. Good effects on allies.  *Creates a shield over an area (4 sec) *HP +400% (10 sec) *HP x 40% Area Recovery (per sec) (10 sec)

skills.name: Digivolve Mega Flame
skills.description: Evolves into Greymon and blows a giant fireball. Bad effects on enemies.  *Continuously cancels enemy invincibility (4 sec) *ATK x 3600% Area Damage  *Stuns enemies (4 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Digimon Adventure
abilities.description: Digimon Adventure Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Stun: Intelligence
abilities.description: Has a high chance of stunning all Intelligence type enemies and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
